title: Synthetic multidisciplinary claim-admission benchmark
description: A deterministic corpus for measuring whether candidate claims are legitimate scoped findings rather than merely quote-bearing text.

checksum_contract.description: Decode as UTF-8, normalize CRLF and bare CR to LF, then hash the bounded canonical text.

limitations: All documents are compact synthetic fixtures and do not estimate arbitrary-domain performance.
The quote-presence baseline intentionally models a weak admission boundary and is expected to fail negative slices.
Human-reviewed live-source quality remains a later review-gated milestone.

baseline.description: Accept a candidate when its non-empty quote occurs in the document and basic candidate text fields are present.
